During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''[[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]''' was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was dispatched to a [[Separatist Ando system base|Separatist base]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]. However, while en-route to the base, the corvette was [[Mission to the Ando system|attacked]] in the Ando [[Star system/Legends|system]] by [[Strike Force Cularin]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. The corvette was bombarded by the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Relentless (cruiser)|''Relentless'']] and the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Alpha Flight (Galactic Republic)|Alpha Flight]], causing the ship to explode. Most of the corvette's crew were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and only four survived: the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] representative [[Solenoid]], the [[Thaereian military]] envoy [[Gura Tran]], the [[Tarasin]] [[Sheel]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rame Cartroll]], the ship's second-in-command. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of Republic-allied freelance agents, subsequently boarded the corvette, to search for survivors and to gather intelligence.
